mentions.name: Vibe Coding Discovery Platform
mentions.description: This open-source social platform lets people discover what others in their network, company, or workspace are building. Bots connect to git repositories, analyze the README and code, and generate an aesthetic UI/UX presentation of each project. Planned features include a gamified token leaderboard and other social quality-of-life features, with the goal of helping people collaborate, pool resources, and avoid duplicating efforts. The platform is designed so groups can self-host it among themselves.
mentions.problem: People lack visibility into what colleagues and network contacts are building, which leads to duplicated efforts and missed collaboration opportunities.
mentions.audience: People in a shared network, company, or workspace who are building software projects, seeking collaborators with similar interests.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently ideating a flow where people can sneak peak into what people in their network/company/worksapce are vibe coding. The basic mvp is to have some bots connected to git repos and analyse readme + code(?) and then create an aesthetic ui/ux on top of it.
